name: Find HSI-Seeded Room Whitespace
jtbd: When an HSI pair scan has surfaced a surprising relationship, check whether its connecting region is sparse in this room while near a supplied set of reference frameworks, so I can decide which connection deserves further research.
runtime: Python >=3.11; local CLI and stdio MCP
requires: At least 3 artifact vectors and 1 reference framework vector
HSI pair results from the same scoped snapshot
All vectors produced with the same embedding model and preprocessing
limitations: Finds room-relative sparse regions only; no external literature, market demand, novelty, or commercial whitespace claim.
Baseline frameworks, embedding quality, and small-corpus percentile stability affect results.
The MindrianOS host must generate embeddings and obtain reference baselines; this capability does not access room paths or remote providers.
source_revision: HSI discover-hsi-whitespace.py mechanism adapted to a host-supplied vector bundle
